part.text:
We have to implement scoring. Points: need to increment score on safe passage events and collectibles. Since we have not defined collectibles yet, we can increment score each time a hazard passes safely (i.e., when hazard goes off-screen out of canvas without colliding). This counts as "passes an obstacle without collision". Or perhaps we can have a simple condition: when hazards get removed after leaving screen, increase score. Also the player is moving forward and obstacles move downwards relative to player? Actually we have forward movement decreasing y (since we defined player.y -= PLAYER_FORWARD_SPEED * dt). The player moves upward (decreasing y). Hazards move downwards. We have currently hazards defined with y starting at -HAZARD_RADIUS (above), moving down with HAZARD_SPEED * dt. The player moving upward may actually approach them. But anyway.

We need to add scoring logic: In update() or updateHazards, when a hazard moves off-screen (y - radius > canvas.height), we can increment score. Also maybe each time the player moves forward (or some time), we could increment score for each dt. Simplify: increment when hazard removed (passed). Also create a "render" function to draw score text at top left. Already we have placeholder render somewhere? Not yet. Let's search for render section.
